response.text:
I can do that — I just need to confirm details before creating the recurring event.

Please either paste the note or confirm the following fields:

- Event title (e.g., "Team Sync")
- Attendees (who do you mean by “everyone”? list email addresses or a group alias)
- Organizer account to use (your calendar email)
- Start date, start time, duration
- Time zone
- Recurrence rule (e.g., weekly on Tuesdays; every 2 weeks; end after N occurrences or end date)
- Location / meeting link (e.g., Zoom link or "Google Meet")
- Description/agenda (optional)
- Whether to send calendar invites to attendees now

Also confirm you want this created as a recurring series on each attendee’s calendar (rather than just an invitation they can accept), and confirm you have permission to add events to those calendars.

Once you provide/confirm these, I will proceed.
